_note: Visiting ships (docs/V3_1_DESIGN.md section 6.1). return_h: visitors start back to the ship this long before it leaves; boarding_wait_h: the ship waits this long for them. Times in game hours (1 day = 24 h = 600 s, so 1 h = 25 s). weight: how often the kind comes. visitors: [min, max] people who walk into the colony. stay_h: time on the pad. The schedule comes from hashes of the seed and the arrival number, never from a random stream, so building or trading never moves a ship.

trader.name: Trader
trader.desc: Sells goods and buys what the colony makes.

shuttle.name: Immigrant shuttle
shuttle.desc: Brings settlers. You choose who stays.

liner.name: Tourist liner
liner.desc: Tourists pay for comfort: a cantina or lounge, good food and a bed.

medical.name: Medical ship
medical.desc: Brings hurt people. Each one treated in a medical bay pays.

science.name: Science ship
science.desc: Visiting scientists add research in your labs. It buys research packs and exotic crystals.

inspector.name: Inspector
inspector.desc: One inspector visits rooms and pays for a well-run colony.
